evals.name: web-planted-issues
evals.prompt: Do a design review of this chores page. The core job is adding a chore and assigning it to someone in the household.
expected_behavior: Declares that evidence is code only and lowers confidence accordingly
Infers a baseline that notes two primary button colors (#2563EB and #1D4ED8) and two corner radii (8px and 4px), and raises a consistency finding with Decision needed
Flags the blank list with no empty state on a core screen as Major
Flags the 2.5-second save with no progress feedback and no double-submit guard as Major
Flags 'Submit' and 'Error 422' as copy findings, and the placeholder-only labels as a web forms convention finding
Flags Delete with no confirmation or undo, and the link used as an action button
Does not raise the low-contrast gray (#b0b0b0) as its own finding; at most tags it as an accessibility handoff
Uses only Blocker, Major, Minor, and Nit, and ends by offering to grill decisions, export issues, or stop

evals.name: ios-planted-issues
evals.prompt: Review the design of this SwiftUI settings screen for my iOS app.
expected_behavior: Reads the iOS reference and asks for or notes the absence of screenshots in light and dark appearance
Flags 'Delete household' as a destructive action with no destructive role, no confirmation, and no undo, rated Blocker
Flags the hidden system back button with a custom '< Back' label, which breaks the expected back affordance and likely the edge swipe
Flags interactiveDismissDisabled on a sheet that has no Cancel action, which traps the user
Flags hard-coded RGB colors with no dark variant
Flags the empty-name row rendering a blank space, the TextField with no label or prompt, and the 'OK' button label
Leaves Dynamic Type and VoiceOver concerns to an accessibility handoff

evals.name: real-app-full-review
evals.prompt: Run a design review of this app.
files: SUPPLY: live URL (Cowork) or screenshots, plus repo access
expected_behavior: Assembles a baseline table with stated and inferred sources, extracted from the repo's styles and components
Builds a screen inventory marking core and first-run screens, and a state matrix for each
Every finding cites a screen, an element, and an evidence source
Lists decisions needed separately and offers Phase 2 without starting it

evals.name: picks-up-handoff-design
files: SUPPLY: a scratch GitHub repo with .app-review.json, the app or screenshots, and an open product-review issue labeled handoff:design
expected_behavior: Lists open handoff:design entries not yet picked up and checks each one's design cause
Writes its own D finding for a confirmed cause, with its own fingerprint
Proposes a pickup comment on the product-review issue that links the new finding, and does not propose closing that issue
